newsitem.title: UK: TREG says KEPIT unitisation too expensive.
newsitem.headline: TREG says KEPIT unitisation too expensive.

text.p: Proposals to turn the Kleinwort European Privatisation Investment Trust Plc into a unit trust could be more expensive than liquidiating the trust's portfolio and will disadvantage small investors, TR European Growth said at a news conference.
"Unitisation schemes still need to incur substantial costs including compensation to warrantholders," said James de Sausmarez of fund manager Henderson Touche Remnant.
TREG, which is managed by Henderson, has launched a hostile bid for KEPIT, which has been rejected by the independent board of KEPIT on grounds of cost.
